attributes.title: alarm_journal
attributes.description: Query bounded historical Alarm Journal transitions via system.alarm.queryJournal. Default range is 24 hours and hard range is 31 days; over-limit results fail rather than truncate.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Optional ISO-8601 instant. Defaults to 24 hours before endTime.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: Optional ISO-8601 instant. Defaults to now.

parameters.name: states
parameters.description: Optional journal states including ClearUnacked, ClearAcked, ActiveUnacked, ActiveAcked, Enabled, Disabled.

parameters.name: priorities
parameters.description: Optional priorities: Diagnostic, Low, Medium, High, Critical.

parameters.name: alarmPaths
parameters.description: Optional Alarm Path patterns; at most 50.

parameters.name: sourcePaths
parameters.description: Optional Source Path patterns; at most 50.

parameters.name: displayPaths
parameters.description: Optional Display Path patterns; at most 50.

parameters.name: providers
parameters.description: Optional Tag Provider names; at most 20.

parameters.name: allProperties
parameters.description: Up to 20 AND property conditions: {property, operator, value}.

parameters.name: anyProperties
parameters.description: Up to 20 OR property conditions: {property, operator, value}.

parameters.name: definedProperties
parameters.description: Property names that must exist; at most 20.

parameters.name: includeData
parameters.description: Reserved for a future bounded associated-data contract. Must be false; true returns unsupported_capability before the native query.

parameters.name: includeSystem
parameters.description: Whether system alarm events are included. Default false.

parameters.name: includeShelved
parameters.description: Whether shelved alarm events are included. Default false.
